document_title: Revisions to Rules and Regulations Tariff Compliance Filing - TRACKED-CHANGES (redline) version of the revised tariff sheets
how_obtained: Fetched the GA PSC FACTS document-detail page /search/facts-document/?documentId=221656 to read its download link, then downloaded the ZIP 'dkt_44280_revisions_to_rules_and_regs_tariff_compliance_filing.zip' from the public API endpoint https://services.psc.ga.gov/api/v1/External/Public/Get/Document/DownloadFile/221656/102762. Unzipped it and took only 'Tracked/DKT 44280 Tracked.pdf'. Its clean twin is saved as ga-44280-rules-regs-tariff-compliance-clean.txt. NOTE: because this is a redline, flat text extraction collapses each deletion and its replacement into a single run - e.g. 'JanuaryApril, 2025' is struck 'January' immediately followed by inserted 'April'. That artefact is left in deliberately. Converted the PDF to text with pdfminer.six extract_text(). Saved exactly as pdfminer emitted it - no reflow, no de-hyphenation, no ligature or soft-hyphen repair; running heads, marginal line-number columns, dot leaders and form feeds all left in place.
